run_DepthMapper: run the DepthMapper process to perform sliding window bundle adjustment on incoming frames
iterate_DepthMapper: iterate one bundle adjustment step building the H and g system and solving for delta
add_keyframe_DepthMapper: add a new keyframe with GP-predicted sparse depth and photo variables to the sliding window
init_keyframe_DepthMapper: initialize the first reference keyframe with precomputed depth variables and pose
get_kf_ref_data_DepthMapper: get the latest keyframe reference data including timestamp, image, pose, affine params, and depth image
get_kf_viz_data_DepthMapper: get visualization data for the latest keyframe including poses, depth, sparse coords, and frame pairs
load_model_DepthMapper: load the NonstationaryGpModule checkpoint and set it to eval mode on the configured device
run_model_DepthMapper: run the GP model on an RGB image to produce Gaussian covariance predictions
prep_predictor_DepthMapper: prepare GP predictor matrices including Cholesky factor, cross-covariance, and inverse standard deviation
initialize_log_depth_DepthMapper: initialize sparse log depth from current depth observations using the GP predictor
